# Jithin Sebastian

> Jithin Sebastian is the Head of Engineering at Mozilor, the company behind the CookieYes consent management platform. He is also Mozilor's Information Security Officer and leads its R&D division.

## Key facts

- Role: Head of Engineering, Information Security Officer and R&D Division Lead at Mozilor (https://www.mozilor.com/)
- Product: CookieYes (https://www.cookieyes.com/), a cookie consent management platform
- Experience: 9 years in software engineering, more than 5 at Mozilor
- Scaled CookieYes from 100,000 to more than 1 million users
- Built data pipelines handling over 3 billion requests a day
- Architected large-scale web scanning infrastructure for cookie scanning
- Areas: backend systems (Node.js, Go, Python), data (Kafka, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL, Redis), cloud (AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform), security and privacy engineering (GDPR), AI in consent management
